channel.desc: Join Pastor Kenny and Chris Shelton, along with their panel of guests, as they explore the greatest Gift ever given to mankind! And that being the Gift of the Son of God. It is in this Gift that we want our total focus to be upon. We want to look at why this Gift was given and what this Gift means for anyone who is willing to receive it.
